name: personal-workbench
description: 本地优先的个人创作工作台

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:app
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:interaction
scripts.check: npm run doctor && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:doctor && npm run typecheck && npm run build:app && npm run test:interaction
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.check:music: node scripts/check-music-storage.mjs && node scripts/check-music.mjs && node scripts/check-local-music.mjs
scripts.check:prototype: node scripts/check-component-prototype.mjs && node scripts/check-builtin-modules.mjs && node scripts/check-dock-transitions.mjs
